Server-backed interactive data table

Source: R/data-table.R
shad_data_table_server.Rd

Experimental server-side paging for shad_data_table(). The table sends a normalized request to source whenever its page, page size, sort, or filter changes. source must return a list with data (a data frame containing at most the requested page), total_rows, and filtered_rows.

Usage

shad_data_table_server(
  id,
  source,
  columns = NULL,
  row_key = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

id

The data-table input id.

source

A function accepting one normalized request list and returning list(data = <data.frame>, total_rows = <integer>, filtered_rows = <integer>).

columns

Optional named list of shad_col() specs. When omitted, column metadata is inferred from the first response.

row_key

Optional stable id column in each response page.

session

The Shiny session.

Value

Invisibly, the Shiny observer driving the source.

Details

The request passed to source has page, page_size, sort (a list of column/direction pairs), and filter (a global string plus named column filters). The response is serialized using the same shad_col() formatters and trusted-HTML rules as the client-side table.

Supply a stable row_key column when selections must survive paging. With row_key = NULL, the existing page-local row-index behavior is retained and is not suitable for cross-page selection. This helper deliberately does not provide editing, grouping, pivoting, aggregation, downloads, or database adapter behavior; the source owns query construction and parameterization.

See also

Other shadshiny data table: shad_col(), shad_data_table(), shad_fmt, update_shad_data_table()
